author: Trail of Bits
who: security research firm that built a working attack to test the flaw
what: A security firm says it has working attacks that take over servers running popular website software, on every recent version of PHP that hasn't been updated. If your site runs on PHP and you haven't updated, assume it can be broken into.
quote: We’ve confirmed exploits work on pre-patch releases of PHP 8.2–8.5.

tweet.name: Trail of Bits
tweet.text:
Our demo shows PHP2Shell giving a shell on MediaWiki, Symfony, Laravel, and phpBB.

We’ve confirmed exploits work on pre-patch releases of PHP 8.2–8.5. If you haven’t updated, assume attackers can compromise your server, and that exploitation will only get easier.

Update: Our PHP exploit is now production-grade.
* stock php.ini-production, display_errors=off, normal memory_limit, multi-worker, ASLR, under load

* MediaWiki, WordPress, phpBB, Laravel
* Apache/mod_php and nginx/php-fpm -> root
